schema_contract: potential_operation_evidence_association(association_id, potential_operation_id, evidence_key, evidence_type, state, rationale_json, created_at) plus assessment binding (assessment_id, association_id)
ownership_invariant: normalized association potential_operation_id must exactly equal target assessment operation; mismatch raises before insert/bind
deterministic_identity: UUIDv5 over owner, evidence identity/type, state, source key, and canonical provenance
shared_evidence: PASS: same evidence for two owners yields distinct association IDs and independent bindings
cross_contamination: PASS: explicit candidate ownership mismatch rolls back with no partial rows
idempotency: PASS: INSERT OR IGNORE with deterministic identity
state_transition: PASS: state participates in identity, preserving UNRESOLVED/INCLUDED/CONTRADICTORY historical assertions
non_derivation: PASS: publisher does not delete candidate-global ledger rows
atomic_publisher_integration: Qualified association persistence is transaction-compatible with existing lineage publisher; real writes not performed
